meta.name: hundred-million-offers
meta.description: Create irresistible offers using the Value Equation, bonus stacking, risk-reversing guarantees, and ethical scarcity. Use when the user mentions "grand slam offer", "make my offer more compelling", "what bonuses should I add", "guarantee strategy", "offer naming", or "people say its too expensive". Also trigger when packaging a product for higher perceived value, justifying premium pricing instead of discounting, designing a money-back guarantee, or structuring tiers to maximize conversions. Covers the MAGIC naming formula and starving-crowd targeting. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For outbound sales, see predictable-revenue.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Create high-converting product offers and promotions

howto.what: 帮你设计让人难以拒绝的产品方案，包括价值公式、叠加赠品、风险逆转保证和道德稀缺性，并给方案打分。
howto.when: 当你提到“大满贯方案”、“让我的方案更诱人”、“该加什么赠品”、“保证策略”、“方案命名”或“别人说太贵”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个让人无法拒绝的课程方案。
我的产品定价 2000 元，怎么让它看起来值 2 万？
say.note: AI 会运用价值公式和赠品堆叠来提升感知价值。

say.text: 给我的 SaaS 产品设计一个退款保证。
say.note: AI 会推荐合适的保证类型并给出文案。

howto.what_en: Helps you craft irresistible offers using the Value Equation, bonus stacking, risk-reversing guarantees, and ethical scarcity, and scores the offer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "grand slam offer", "make my offer more compelling", "what bonuses should I add", "guarantee strategy", "offer naming", or "people say it's too expensive".

say_en.text: Design an irresistible offer for my online course.
say_en.note: AI will generate a full package with core, bonuses, guarantee, and scarcity.

say_en.text: My product costs $2000. How to make it feel worth $20,000?
say_en.note: AI uses the Value Equation and bonus stacking to boost perceived value.

say_en.text: Create a money-back guarantee for my SaaS product.
say_en.note: AI recommends guarantee type and provides copy.
